row.body: Field plots: weekly soil checks. Road access may close at short notice. Reverse: “Keep the old mare in the dry stall tonight.”
row.title: Temporary field access card
row.gloss: A field card gives routine soil duties and a personal reminder.
row.rival_reading: A county worker could receive temporary plot access during an emergency survey; the animal reminder is private and does not establish a malfunction.

row.body: The map's crop row reaches the road and stops at a thumb-smudged mark. Soil fills the shovel socket but not the blade; its grip is clean.
row.title: The row that ends at the road
row.gloss: A marked field row and a tool carry different traces.
row.rival_reading: A response crew could survey a field after access changed and carry a clean tool; the marked row need not belong to a program.
